price_below_threshold.detail: Export price {price} is below the {threshold} threshold — stopping export.

price_not_below_threshold.title: Export allowed
price_not_below_threshold.detail: Export price {price} is not below the {threshold} threshold.

stop_export_unsupported.title: Stop-export unavailable
stop_export_unsupported.detail: The inverter cannot stop export; {skippedSlots} slot(s) skipped.

hold_window_applied.title: Hold charging
hold_window_applied.detail: Holding charge for {neededKwh} kWh; release {releaseSlot} (bound by {boundBy}).

no_room_to_hold.title: No room to hold
no_room_to_hold.detail: Need {neededKwh} kWh but only {surplusAtWindowStart} kWh surplus at window start.

cheaper_slot_chosen.title: Cheaper slot chosen
cheaper_slot_chosen.detail: A cheaper slot was chosen (worst chosen {chosenPrice}).

window_covered.title: Window covered
window_covered.detail: SoC stays at {projectedMinSoc}% over {expensiveWindow}; no bridge needed.

no_cheap_band.title: No cheap band
no_cheap_band.detail: No preceding cheap band to charge from.

runtime_deficit_placed.title: Run appliance
runtime_deficit_placed.detail: Placed {placedHours} h toward {minHours} h ({doneHours} h already done).

ranked_more_expensive.title: Ranked more expensive
ranked_more_expensive.detail: Costlier than the chosen slots (worst chosen {worstChosenCost}).

price_above_run_threshold.title: Price too high to run
price_above_run_threshold.detail: Export price is not below the {threshold} threshold, so this slot cannot be used.

forced_after_consecutive_skips.title: Forced after skips
forced_after_consecutive_skips.detail: No condition group matched, but {consecutiveSkips} consecutive skips would exceed the limit — placed {placedHours} h anyway.

conditions_matched.title: Conditions matched
conditions_matched.detail: Every condition allows this slot, and there is no daily minimum to cap the run.

soc_below_threshold.title: Battery too low
soc_below_threshold.detail: Projected battery {soc}% is below the {threshold}% threshold.

insufficient_solar_coverage.title: Not enough solar
insufficient_solar_coverage.detail: Solar surplus covers only {coveragePct}% of this appliance's demand here; {requiredPct}% is required.

would_break_soc_floor.title: Would drain the battery
would_break_soc_floor.detail: Running here would take the battery down to {projectedMinSoc}% at {atSlot}, below the {floor}% floor.

soc_floor_already_breached.title: Battery already runs out
soc_floor_already_breached.detail: The battery drops to {baselineMinSoc}% — below the {floor}% floor — even without this appliance, so it cannot run self-sufficiently.

not_solar_neutral.title: The day would not pay for itself
not_solar_neutral.detail: Running here leaves the day {deltaSocPct}% down on battery and {deltaImportKwh} kWh up on grid import, so the sun did not cover it.

blocked_user_owned.title: Blocked (user)
blocked_user_owned.detail: A user-owned action on {domain} blocks this write.

condition_unmet.title: Won't run — condition not met
condition_unmet.detail: Placed as a candidate for display only; it will not execute because this automation's execution condition is not currently met.

optimizer_skipped.title: Optimizer skipped
optimizer_skipped.detail: This optimizer was skipped this run.

unexplained.title: Unexplained
unexplained.detail: No explanation was recorded for this slot (instrumentation gap).

out_of_scope_default.title: Not considered
out_of_scope_default.detail: This slot was outside this optimizer's scope.
